breadth_decision.decision: BREADTH: v0.16.0 leaves the deterministic-observation setting for the first time and studies iid observation noise. Larger alphabets are deferred to v0.17.0.
reasons: Versions 0.12.0-0.15.0 all refined certification speed / coverage on the same deterministic synthetic Moore worlds with 2-bit readings; marginal gains were small (RSXL dC about +0.05) and the headline mechanisms mostly reduced to RG_FB (Exact lemma in plan 017).

Every certificate so far is unsound under a single flipped observation bit (Inferred: a flipped bit can eliminate the true machine from the region, after which the region may force a wrong reading). Robustness to noise is a precondition for any general-intelligence claim; a larger alphabet changes the size of the problem, not its kind.

Noise forces the first honest probabilistic soundness label in the project: the guarantee becomes Exact conditional on an event (flips <= m) plus an exactly computed probability bound for that event, instead of an unconditional Exact.
The tolerant region is a small additive change (one cardinality constraint over flip variables in the frozen CNF region), so the study stays within the 2 h cap and the existing process controls.
breadth_decision.label: Inferred (design judgement, recorded before any v0.16.0 code or data exists)

noise_model.definition: Each OBSERVED (unmasked) bit of every reading, including the initial one, is flipped independently with probability eps; masked bits are unaffected; actions are noise-free. The latent (noise-free) reading is the scoring truth.
noise_model.attested_bound: eps_bar = 0.02 (caller attestation, like FB): eps0, eps1, eps2 are inside it; eps5_stress is OUTSIDE it and has no guarantee.
noise_model.flip_rng: numpy.random.default_rng([target_seed, round(1000*eps), 18]) drawn after the mask; realized flips per case are recorded (Exact count).
noise_model.label: Simulated (synthetic iid noise; real sensors are not iid)

tolerant_region.RGN_n(m): RegionK(n) with one fresh flip variable per observed bit (the bit's clause is relaxed to 'observed value XOR flip') and the cardinality constraint sum(flips) <= m (pysat CardEnc seqcounter); a latent reading bit is certified when every member of the region agrees on it (support is a singleton), exactly as RG.
tolerant_region.m_rule: m = smallest integer with P(Bin(B, eps_bar) > m) <= delta, delta = 0.01, where B = number of observed bits in the full 45-reading trajectory, fixed before the first action (B depends only on the mask). Computed with exact rational arithmetic.
tolerant_region.lemma_conditional_Exact: If the realized flips on a trajectory are <= m and the true machine has <= n states, the true machine is in RGN_n(m) at every step, so every RGN_n(m) certificate equals the latent reading (no false certificate on that case).
tolerant_region.bound_unconditional: Under the noise model with eps <= eps_bar, P(case has any false RGN4 certificate) <= P(flips > m) <= delta = 0.01 per case (Exact as a probability statement under the model; Simulated with respect to real noise).
tolerant_region.label: Exact conditional on (flips <= m, n* <= FB); probabilistic (<= delta per case) unconditionally under the iid model; no guarantee when eps > eps_bar or noise is not iid

g11_rate_projection.why: study-017 g11 (second-implementation audit) was projected at 27.0 worker-s per case (11651 s / 432) and measured 46.4 (14303.6 s / 308 cases; 1.72x); unaliased2 cost about 77 s per case and ood4 at mask 0.6 about 72 s. It hit its 2400 s stream budget with 308/432 audited and GS_ref5 FAILED (STUDY_BUDGET). Observed, BRUTE_DEVIATIONS_017_ADDENDUM_3.md.
rule: (1) the audit cost per case is measured on smoke seeds for EVERY family x mask cell (at least 2 cases per cell, all 12 cells, plus 2 stress cases), with the same worker count and the same concurrent streams (gti, transfer) as the held-out run, not alone
(2) projected g11 wall = sum over cells of (cases in cell x the cell's slowest smoke case) / workers, times a safety factor of 1.75 (at least the 1.72 underestimate observed in study-017)

(3) the source freeze records the projection; if it exceeds 0.8 of the g11 budget, the plan must, BEFORE the source freeze, raise the g11 budget, raise workers within the 8-worker cap, or start g11 alongside transfer; only if none fits, reduce the audited sample by a stated rule in a pre-freeze deviation; the sample is never cut after held-out data exist
(4) if the projected wall cannot fit under the 7200 s cap, the run does not start; a deviation records the new budget and the reason
(5) g11 writes PROGRESS every 60 s with a projected finish (cases done, mean cost, ETA); an ETA past the budget is logged as an early warning only: no mid-run change to budget, sample or workers
(6) the same projection rule (factor 1.75, measured under concurrency) applies to gti, which used 3463 s of its 3600 s budget in study-017 (0.962)
g11_rate_projection.check: scripts/rate_math_018.py prints the per-cell table and exits non-zero if any stream's projected wall x 1.75 > its budget; its output is committed before the source freeze and is part of the freeze (G_RT clause (i) remains the scored outcome)

stop_rule.operator_wait: the operator polls live processes with short checks (<= 240 s blocking waits) during the run; study-017's two heartbeat gaps (425.7 s, 316.5 s) each ended within about 1 s of the operator's next tool call after a long blocking wait (Observed timing; cause Inferred: host deschedules the box while the operator is idle). G_HB is unchanged (<= 30 s).
